title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Expanded presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see
summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing presenter visibility in "Manage what attendees see" by allowing event organizers and producers to drag and resize the presenter panel, displaying more presenters simultaneously. This improves monitoring, transitions, and management of large events. The update rolls out from mid-August to November 2026 automatically, requiring no admin action.
body:
Updated November 3, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience.

[What and why]

Microsoft Teams is expanding presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see for Teams events. Event organizers and producers can now drag and resize the presenter panel, allowing them to view more presenters simultaneously during event production.

This improvement helps producers more easily monitor available presenters, streamline presenter transitions, and manage large events with greater efficiency.

This message is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 567467.

[Rollout schedule]

- Targeted Release: Beginning mid-August 2026 and expected to complete by late August 2026- General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Beginning late August 2026 and expected to complete by end of November 2026 (previously end of October)[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Teams event organizers- Teams event producers- Users who manage live event production experiences in Microsoft TeamsPlatforms and services

- Microsoft Teams- Teams eventsWhat will happen

- Users will be able to drag and resize the presenter panel in Manage what attendees see.- The larger presenter panel can display more presenters at one time.- Users can view more presenters at once, reducing the need to switch between pages when managing large events.- Producers will have improved visibility into presenter availability during events.- Presenter transitions can be managed more efficiently, particularly during large events with many presenters.- This change is enabled automatically and does not require configuration.[Action required and recommendations]

No admin action is required.

You may want to:

- Inform event organizers and producers about the updated presenter management experience.- Update internal training materials and event production guidance, if applicable.[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
bodyHtml:
Updated November 3, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience.

[What and why]

Microsoft Teams is expanding presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see for Teams events. Event organizers and producers can now drag and resize the presenter panel, allowing them to view more presenters simultaneously during event production.

This improvement helps producers more easily monitor available presenters, streamline presenter transitions, and manage large events with greater efficiency.

This message is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 567467.

[Rollout schedule]

  • Targeted Release: Beginning mid-August 2026 and expected to complete by late August 2026
  • General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Beginning late August 2026 and expected to complete by end of November 2026 (previously end of October)

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

  • Teams event organizers
  • Teams event producers
  • Users who manage live event production experiences in Microsoft Teams

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams
  • Teams events

What will happen

  • Users will be able to drag and resize the presenter panel in Manage what attendees see.
  • The larger presenter panel can display more presenters at one time.
  • Users can view more presenters at once, reducing the need to switch between pages when managing large events.
  • Producers will have improved visibility into presenter availability during events.
  • Presenter transitions can be managed more efficiently, particularly during large events with many presenters.
  • This change is enabled automatically and does not require configuration.

[Action required and recommendations]

No admin action is required.

You may want to:

  • Inform event organizers and producers about the updated presenter management experience.
  • Update internal training materials and event production guidance, if applicable.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
